objects.name: Isla
objects.scan: Isla, a pink moon. Rose-coloured regolith, rich in manganese minerals, glows softly in Altair's white light. Its parent's magnetic field funnels the stellar wind onto both poles, where a rainbow aurora dances day and night. Comms reports an unusual signal: it's broadcasting a song. Requested by a young member of the crew's family.

objects.name: Graham
objects.scan: Graham, a lava moon. Tidal heating from its parent and the nearby star keeps the mantle molten: a black basalt crust split by glowing seams, and two active volcanoes that throw lava high above the surface. Comms reports an unusual signal: it's broadcasting a song.
